title: Public Opinion as an Option: Leveraging Prediction Markets to Hedge Exposure to Spot Crypto Volatility
abstract: arXiv:2609.14267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes an investment strategy through resource allocation into Kalshi Crypto Event Contracts in order to effectively hedge exposure to spot asset volatility. Using Bitcoin as a proof of concept, we treat corresponding Kalshi markets on the asset's future price as option contracts, and through construction of different portfolio allocations present a framework for which event contracts can be effectively utilized by retail investors in order to control risk framework without reducing underlying exposure to spot volatility. We showcase this information through analysis of three separate Kalshi event contracts, all relating to a different underlying market regime (i.e bullish, bearish, flat), and provide a comprehensive risk profile for each regime. translated_title: 公众舆论作为期权：利用预测市场对冲现货加密货币波动性风险
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种通过将资源配置到Kalshi加密货币事件合约中的投资策略，以有效对冲现货资产波动性风险。以比特币作为概念验证，我们将Kalshi上关于该资产未来价格的相应市场视为期权合约，并通过构建不同的投资组合配置，提出了一个框架，使散户投资者能够有效利用事件合约来控制风险，同时不减少对现货波动性的底层风险敞口。我们通过对三个不同Kalshi事件合约的分析来展示这一方法，每个合约对应不同的底层市场状态（即牛市、熊市、平稳），并为每种市场状态提供全面的风险画像。结果表明，动态的Kalshi/比特币对冲策略在所有市场状态下都优于更简单的投资组合，支持了我们最初的假设。我们还讨论了进一步的考量。
tldr: 本文创新性地将Kalshi预测市场的事件合约视为期权工具，提出了利用动态对冲策略来控制比特币现货波动性风险的新框架，并证明该策略在牛市、熊市和平稳三种市场状态下均优于简单投资组合。
en_tdlr: This paper innovatively treats Kalshi prediction market event contracts as option instruments, proposing a dynamic hedging framework to control Bitcoin spot volatility risk, and demonstrates that this strategy outperforms simpler portfolios across bullish, bearish, and flat market regimes.
